note: Recurring cast. Images and TTS read gender/voice/description from here. A lesson picks 2–4 of them by place; images rotate pairs (see 00 §10). Voices are assigned in code per character, fixed for life. Descriptions are appearance only (no nationality) so images are reusable across target languages.
